name: Love To Hate You
source:
You lost your job. Forced to move into a shared apartment, you quickly realize you're going to be living with the people who got you fired.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你丢了工作。被迫搬进合租公寓，你很快意识到你将和那些让你被解雇的人住在一起。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
